expected_legal_propositions: Obtaining a public contract through forged electronic records constitutes forgery under BNS
Admissibility of electronic records and extraction reports requires certification under BSA Section 63
Police custody and remand are governed under BNSS Section 187 with maximum 15-day custody
prohibited_false_propositions: BNS governs police custody and remand
Electronic records are inadmissible unless original hardware is permanently produced in court
ADV-001.uncertainty_focus: Attribution of digital alterations requires examination of device metadata

expected_legal_propositions: POCSO Act applies to victims under 18 years of age and remains an unrepealed independent statute
Threatening to publish private intimate photos to induce property or compliance constitutes extortion and criminal intimidation under BNS
Screenshots and chat messages must satisfy electronic record admissibility standards under BSA
prohibited_false_propositions: POCSO was repealed or subsumed into BNS
ADV-002.uncertainty_focus: Exact ages of parties on date of alleged incident

expected_legal_propositions: Homicide is classified under BNS Section 103 (Murder) or Section 105 (Culpable homicide not amounting to murder)
Right of private defence is governed under BNS Sections 38 to 44 and does not extend to inflicting more harm than necessary
Recovery of weapon upon disclosure statement is governed under BSA discovery principles
prohibited_false_propositions: Private defence allows unlimited retaliation after threat has ceased
ADV-003.uncertainty_focus: Immediacy and proportionality of apprehension of death or grievous hurt

expected_legal_propositions: Altering regulatory notices to induce investment transfers constitutes Cheating under BNS Section 318 and Forgery under BNS Section 336
Lack of guilty knowledge by an account holder negates common intention or conspiracy under BNS
Cloud ledger copies and electronic records require BSA certification
prohibited_false_propositions: Civil contractual dispute precludes all criminal fraud liability if fraudulent inducement existed at inception
ADV-004.uncertainty_focus: Whether inducement was fraudulent at the inception or subsequent commercial failure

expected_legal_propositions: Repeatedly following or monitoring a woman online despite disinterest constitutes Stalking under BNS Section 78
GPS tracker data and electronic logs require provenance attribution under BSA
prohibited_false_propositions: Stalking is only an offence if physical contact occurs
ADV-005.uncertainty_focus: Attribution of SIM card or device to the specific accused

expected_legal_propositions: Extortion under BNS Section 308 requires intentionally putting a person in fear of injury to deliver property
Demanding repayment of lawful debt accompanied by unlawful threats of injury may constitute criminal intimidation under BNS Section 351 or extortion under Section 308
Edited screenshots require proof of context and completeness under BSA
prohibited_false_propositions: Lawful debt completely immunizes against criminal intimidation charges
ADV-006.uncertainty_focus: Completeness of chat logs and whether threats were extortionate or debt assertions

expected_legal_propositions: First-time undertrial offender who has never been previously convicted is eligible for release on bail after undergoing detention for one-third of the maximum imprisonment period under BNSS Section 479
Pending separate cases must be evaluated under statutory exceptions to undertrial bail
prohibited_false_propositions: Undertrial detention can exceed the maximum prescribed imprisonment period
ADV-007.uncertainty_focus: Whether the accused is legally a first-time offender without previous convictions

expected_legal_propositions: Under BNSS Section 35(3), police are mandated to issue a notice of appearance for offences punishable with up to 7 years imprisonment where arrest is not immediately required
Non-compliance with notice does not give arbitrary arrest power without recording reasons
prohibited_false_propositions: Police have unfettered discretion to arrest without notice for offences under 7 years
ADV-008.uncertainty_focus: Whether investigating officer recorded specific statutory reasons for arrest

expected_legal_propositions: Substantive penal liability is governed by the law in force on date of offence (Article 20(1) Constitution & BNS Section 358)
Pending proceedings instituted under CrPC continue under CrPC 1973 per BNSS Section 531(2)(a)
BNS replaced IPC, BNSS replaced CrPC, and BSA replaced IEA on 1 July 2024
prohibited_false_propositions: Substantive offences committed in 2022 can be retrospectively punished under BNS
ADV-009.uncertainty_focus: Exact date of offence and date of institution of proceedings

expected_legal_propositions: Dishonest removal of movable property from warehouse constitutes Theft under BNS Section 303
Fingerprint evidence on authorized objects must be corroborated and CCTV gaps require contextual proof
prohibited_false_propositions: Presence of fingerprint on an authorized workspace object constitutes conclusive proof of theft without corroboration
ADV-010.uncertainty_focus: Whether accused had lawful access to the object during ordinary work hours

Procedural powers of arrest, remand, and trial are governed under BNSS
Electronic and forensic evidence must comply with BSA certification
